Class BankTransactionSelector

public inherited sharing class BankTransactionSelector

Selector for BankTransaction__c. Centralizes SOQL access to bank-transaction records and exposes results through a typed Result inner class that extends Tools.QueryResult, so callers receive consistent error and record-list handling across all queries.

Methods

public static BankTransactionSelector.Result getPendingTransactions()

Returns BankTransaction__c records whose Status__c is in the comma-delimited list configured under CodeSettings__mdt.BANKTRANSACTION_STATUS_ONGOING, ordered by most-recent first. Used to identify in-flight transactions whose final status still needs to be reconciled with Mercury.

Returns:
    Result: query result wrapping the matching BankTransaction__c records

public static BankTransactionSelector.Result getTransactionById(String transactionId)

Returns the BankTransaction__c record matching the given Id with the fields needed for status reconciliation (EstimatedDeliveryDate__c, ExternalId__c, Status__c, PostedDate__c) and the originating bank account's effective external Id via Origin__r.EffectiveExternalId__c.

Parameters:
    transactionId – The BankTransaction__c.Id to match
